player_prompt.intro:
Tadakkest Ṭawer n Uhawi d {num_disks} ṭawer.
Tesriḍ ad tesleḍ ṭawer seg Ṭawer A ɣer Ṭawer C.
Akken ad tesleḍ ṭawer, ira d Ṭawer n tazwara d Ṭawer n targit (amseggas, '[A C]').
Meḍḍel-aɣ, nezmer ad nesleḍ ṭawer n uzwu n Ṭawer, d wakken ṭawer meqqer ur yezmir ara ad yettwasezwar ɣef ṭawer meẓẓiy.
Deg krayat, ṣumm ad tesleḍ yiwen n uẓeṭṭa.
